findings.highlight: "…Still, I know you'll just see through others' requests to the very end no matter what I say, won't you, Haruki-kun?"
findings.evidenceJa:
『…なんて言っても、
頼まれたらやめられないのが春希くんだよね』
findings.explanation: Haruki being unable to refuse when asked becomes always seeing requests through to completion.
findings.japanese:
『…なんて言っても、
頼まれたらやめられないのが春希くんだよね』
findings.todokanai: "…Still, I know you'll just see through others' requests to the very end no matter what I say, won't you, Haruki-kun?"

findings.highlight: thinking I'd be super curious about it
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が見たら、絶対にちくんとすることを、しっかり残しておく
findings.explanation: Haruki notices Setsuna deliberately left in words guaranteed to prick or sting him when he read them. The English says she wanted to make him curious, replacing the slight poison and newly returning candor that the next lines explicitly analyze.
findings.japanese:
俺が見たら、絶対にちくんとすることを、
しっかり残しておくのはなんでなんだろうな。
findings.todokanai: She probably kept them there on purpose, thinking I'd be super curious about it or something.

findings.highlight: letting her go off on her own
findings.evidenceJa: バイト三日目でもうフル参戦ってのは、負担だった
findings.explanation: Haruki worries that making Koharu participate at full capacity on only her third day was too heavy a burden. The English says she was sent off to work on her own, inventing isolation rather than the intensity of full participation.
findings.japanese:
…やっぱりバイト三日目でもうフル参戦ってのは、
負担だったんじゃないだろうか？
findings.todokanai: …Was letting her go off on her own on only the third day too much for her to handle after all?

findings.highlight: "The way you put it sounds awfully disrespectful toward me… Not that I would disagree, though."
findings.evidenceJa:
「そういう言い方、
わたしに対して失礼だと思います。
…あえて指摘しませんけど」
findings.explanation: Koharu says she will refrain from pointing out Haruki's disrespect, while the English says she does not disagree with his rejection.
findings.japanese:
「そういう言い方、
わたしに対して失礼だと思います。
…あえて指摘しませんけど」
findings.todokanai: "The way you put it sounds awfully disrespectful toward me… Not that I would disagree, though."

findings.highlight: Just when I thought she'd become a bit more modest.
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっとは素直になったと思ったのに。
findings.explanation: Haruki thought Koharu had become more honest or straightforward; the English says more modest.
findings.japanese: ちょっとは素直になったと思ったのに。
findings.todokanai: Just when I thought she'd become a bit more modest.

findings.evidenceJa: 今年いっぱいで終わるかも
findings.explanation: Haruki says the short-term job may end by the close of the current year. The English says he may stop only after New Year's, shifting the endpoint across the holiday boundary central to Setsuna's question about visiting.
findings.japanese:
『それに、このバイトは短期だし、
もしかしたら、今年いっぱいで終わるかも』
findings.todokanai: "Also, this is a short-term job, and I might even stop coming after New Year's."

findings.explanation: Haruki corrects the phrase to 語るに落ちた, meaning that someone's own speech inadvertently reveals the truth. The English glosses it as being “done for,” failing precisely where the scene pauses to correct Satou's Japanese and then reuses the phrase.
findings.todokanai: "You mean to say that I'm done for."

findings.evidenceJa: すっかり全員の認識が統一されてしまっていた
findings.explanation: By the time Haruki notices the staff eavesdropping, everyone's understanding has consolidated around the same mistaken conclusion that he and Koharu are involved. The English says Haruki and Koharu reconciled, inventing resolution instead of the collective misunderstanding driving the rest of the scene.
findings.japanese:
ドア越しに聞き耳を立てているスタッフが多すぎて、
店の回転に支障が出かけていると気づいた時には、
すっかり全員の認識が統一されてしまっていた。
findings.todokanai: But when we realized that the number of people pressing their ears on the other side of the door was enough to be a serious detriment to the restaurant, we reconciled almost immediately.

findings.evidenceJa: 『自分に絞れ』という意思表示にも取れます
findings.explanation: Satou says Mari's denial can be read as signaling that Haruki should narrow his choice to her alone. The English's “choked herself” is unrelated and deletes the romantic interpretation that prompts Haruki's Japanese-language rebuke.
findings.japanese: 「『自分に絞れ』という意思表示にも取れますが」
findings.todokanai: "I think she just choked herself with what she said there…"
